name: claim_my_recent
xsql:
SELECT c.claim_id                                              AS claim_id,
       c.period_name                                           AS period_name,
       c.order_code                                            AS order_code,
       c.item_code                                             AS item_code,
       FormatNumber(Nvl(c.claim_amount, 0), '$#,###0.00')      AS claim_amount,
       c.status                                                AS status,
       Nvl(FormatDateTime(c.submitted_date, 'dd MMM yyyy'), '') AS submitted_date
FROM   claim.claim_request c
WHERE  c.employee_id = :v_employee_id
ORDER BY c.submitted_date DESC, c.claim_id DESC
